name: video-watch
description: Make, voice and review videos by chatting. ElevenLabs voices (pick by listening), voiceover, music and sound effects, plus watching any video like a person. Nothing to install.
long_description:
Video Watch lets anyone make and improve videos in Claude without technical setup.

- **Watch any video** (YouTube link or a file on your Mac): scene-by-scene contact sheets, a timestamped transcript, cuts and silences.
- **Pick a voice by listening**: a page opens with your ElevenLabs voices and the whole public voice library, with free previews.
- **Voiceover, music and sound effects** with your own ElevenLabs account; music automatically gets quieter under the voice.
- **Quality brief**: Claude asks the questions that decide how a video turns out (goal, audience, format, length, tone, voice, music, brand) before spending anything.

ffmpeg and the video downloader are built in. Your original videos are never changed. Requires an ElevenLabs API key (elevenlabs.io → Developers → API Keys).
